constraints.statement: TGA packages MUST preserve TSMM as the canonical semantic authority for active trust-system modeling.
Active TGA semantic mappings MUST use stable TSMM semantic identifiers from the v0.24.0 semantic concept registry when such identifiers exist.
TGA decision receipts MUST be treated as TSMM-profiled trust decisions and effects with Trust Graph provenance extensions, not as a competing semantic model.
Machine-readable decision outcomes SHOULD use TSMM canonical terms. Local Trust Graph vocabulary MAY be retained only when an explicit mapping is available.

The assuranceLevel field in active TGA receipts represents contextual assurance posture. Executable assurance rigor MUST be represented by an explicit portable assurance profile such as TIS AL1-AL4 when required.
Essay provenance MUST NOT be treated as runtime evidence. Runtime evidence belongs in evidence references or portable evidence artifacts.

Runtime assurance packages MUST identify the pre-effect governance surface: actor, requested effect, trust boundary, authority basis, policy references, evidence references, revocation or status check, decision, and receipt expectation.
Authority graph semantics MUST distinguish authority origin, delegated actor, scope, policy constraint, publication or discovery surface, and revocation behavior.

TGA MUST NOT claim that TSMM depends on TGA. The alignment direction is downstream consumption: TSMM owns canonical semantics and TGA profiles those semantics into an interpretation and assurance corpus.
